konu: School Life: Daily Routines, Stative Verbs, School Idioms and Simple Present vs Present Continuous
ciktilar: ENG.10.1.3. Günlük rutinler ve anlık eylemler arasındaki farkı ayırt edebilme
ENG.10.1.4. Durum fiillerini (stative verbs) ve okul deyimlerini doğru bağlamda kullanabilme
hatirla: Stative verbs (know, believe, understand, prefer) express states rather than dynamic actions and rarely take -ing.
Common school idioms: 'hit the books' (study hard), 'eager beaver' (enthusiastic worker), 'pass with flying colours'.
Simple Present expresses regular habits and timetables, whereas Present Continuous expresses actions happening right now.

sorular.soru: Read the statements about English verbs and tenses and mark as True or False.

ifadeler.metin: Stative verbs describing feelings and thoughts rarely take continuous -ing forms.
Present Continuous tense is exclusively used for universal laws and fixed timetables.
The idiom 'eager beaver' describes a very hardworking and willing student.
The verb 'prefer' takes continuous form when an activity happens at this moment.

sorular.soru: Identify whether the statements about school routines are True or False.

ifadeler.metin: Adverbs of frequency like 'always' and 'never' typically modify simple present.
The phrase 'at present' indicates regular habits repeated every morning.
'Pass with flying colours' signifies scoring extraordinarily well on a test.
Dynamic verbs can never take the -ing suffix under any grammatical rule.

sorular.soru: Explain why stative verbs like 'understand' are rarely used in continuous tense forms.
sorular.cevap: They express ongoing mental states rather than physical dynamic actions.
